Article id: configure-online-appointment-booking
Article: Set up and manage online appointment booking for patients
Enable patients to schedule routine visits directly through the web and mobile portal by configuring your scheduling rules. Only providers with active schedules and visit types marked as 'Online Eligible' will appear to patients.

1. Go to **Settings > Patient Portal > Booking Rules**.
2. Toggle on **Allow Online Appointment Booking**.
3. Navigate to **Scheduling > Visit Types**, select a visit type, and check the box for **Available Online**.
4. Under **Settings > Schedule > Provider Availability**, designate which staff members accept online requests.

**Limits & Conditions:**
Patients can only book appointments between 24 hours and 60 days in advance. Urgent visit types cannot be made available online.

**Troubleshooting:**
If a provider does not appear for booking, verify their schedule template is published and that their assigned rooms are active under **Settings > Facility > Rooms**.

Ticket:
Configuring online patient booking restrictions and visit types

Hello, We are interested in configuring the online appointment booking feature for our patient portal so that individuals can schedule routine checkups and follow-up visits on their own. Could you please provide guidance on how to restrict this online booking capability to specific providers while excluding others, as well as how to limit which visit types are available through the public-facing portal? We want to make sure specialty consults still require staff approval before getting onto the calendar. Thank you!

Auto-reply:
To restrict online booking to certain providers, go to **Settings > Schedule > Provider Availability** and select only the staff members who should accept online requests. For visit‑type control, open **Scheduling > Visit Types**, choose each routine check‑up or follow‑up you want patients to book, and check **Available Online**. Leave specialty consults unchecked so they remain staff‑only. Remember to enable the feature via **Settings > Patient Portal > Booking Rules** and turn on **Allow Online Appointment Booking**.
